title: Structural Beauty: A Structure-based Approach to Quantifying the Beauty of an Image
reasoning: The paper proposes a computational method to quantify the aesthetic quality of an image based on its structural properties. Although the abstract mentions that this shared notion of beauty exists regardless of 'faiths, cultures, and ethnicities,' the paper's core focus is on the mathematical and computational model itself. It does not evaluate or benchmark any aspects of faith, religion, or ethics.
